dedupe_keys.name: indicators of the condition of the pavement of the bicycle network

description: Indicators of the condition of the pavement of the bicycle network is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. The City of Montreal is responsible for the development, maintenance and management of the network of bicycle paths located on its territory. Knowledge of the condition and condition of this network is an important element in the process of management, determining needs and establishing an adequate level of service for users. Coverage: Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. Its tags are PolearTM, SIRR, Pavement condition, performance indicator, bike path. It offers 3 resource(s) in GPKG, HTML. The portal shows 2026-09-23 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons 4.0 Attribution (CC-BY) licence – Quebec. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
